description: Batch email validation for list cleaning: up to 10 addresses per call, 40% cheaper than 10 single calls. JSON body {emails:[...]}. Each item gets syntax, MX, disposable, role and free-provider checks and a deliverable_guess. Bad items return per-item errors, not a failed call. Price $0.006 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"count":2,"succeeded":2,"failed":0,"results":[{"input":"jane@acme.com","ok":true,"result":{"deliverable_guess":"likely"}},{"input":"bob@mailinator.com","ok":true,"result":{"disposable":true,"deliverable_guess":"risky"}}]}
name: email_check_batch
